title: neltuma denudans
intro: Neltuma denudans, commonly known as Neltuma, is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. This plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Neltuma denudans include acting as an anti-anxiety agent, due to its ability to modulate the central nervous system, and its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents of Neltuma denudans include alkaloids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
